1) Go to places
- Go to a named location: e.g., “go to table A”, “go to the kitchen”, “return to home”.
- Go to exact coordinates: e.g., “go to x=3.2, y=1.5, facing 90 degrees”.

2) Move relative to where I am
- Move forward/backward: e.g., “move forward 2 meters”, “back up 50 centimeters”.
- Move sideways: e.g., “shift left 1 meter”, “move right 30 cm”.
- Rotate in place: e.g., “turn left 45 degrees”, “turn right 90 degrees”.

3) Manage saved locations
- List known places: “what locations do you know?”, “where can you go?”.
- Save the current spot: “save this as table G”, “remember this as charging dock”.
- Delete a saved spot (with confirmation): “forget table G”, “delete charging dock”.

4) Monitor and control navigation
- Stop immediately: “stop”, “cancel navigation”, “halt”.
- Always verify where the robot ended up after a move.
